title: Kinh tế và Quản lý Sử dụng Tài Nguyên Nước

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of water resources in economic terms.
Comprehend the economics of public water supply and domestic water use.
Grasp the economic aspects of irrigation water supply.
Understand the economic implications of hydropower generation.
Learn about the economic considerations in flood control and coastal protection.
Gain knowledge on government management of water resources.
